amphipit.label: The Book Pit
amphipit.blurb: The floor goes down in rings, like a theatre, and the lowest rings are made of books. Someone has left a chair at the bottom to watch them.

amphitheatre.label: The Amphitheatre
amphitheatre.blurb: Terraces of seats go down to a stage and a lectern with a book left open on it. The acoustics are perfect. You could hear a page turn.

antgalleries.label: The Ant Galleries
antgalleries.blurb: The north wall is full of libraries, hundreds of them, each the size of a shoebox and each with its lamp lit. Nobody could read in any of them. Somebody keeps them dusted.

apse.label: The Apse
apse.blurb: Pews, and at the end of them a lectern under a half-dome, with the candles lit. Whatever is going to be read out, you have arrived in time for it.

aqueduct.label: The Aqueduct
aqueduct.blurb: A causeway on stone arches crosses the hall two metres above the books. It carries no water and leads from one staircase to another, and people walk it anyway, slowly, as if it went somewhere.

arcade.label: The Arcade
arcade.blurb: Two rows of arches run away from you to a point, a lamp hung in every one. Count them if you like. You will get a different number coming back.

arcadering.label: The Arcade Loop
arcadering.blurb: A vaulted walk goes round a block of solid stone, with books set into its outside. You go round it twice looking for a door. There is no door.

archmaze.label: The Arches
archmaze.blurb: Arch after arch after arch, and some of them are full of books. The way on is always the one next to the one you picked.

balcony.label: The Balcony Room
balcony.blurb: A gallery runs all the way round, just above the doors. From up there the tables below look like a diagram of themselves.

balustrades.label: The Balustrade Maze
balustrades.blurb: A maze you can see over. It does not make it any shorter. Climbing over is allowed, but somehow it feels like cheating.

benches.label: The Benches
benches.blurb: Everyone here is facing the same blank wall and the one green sign on it. You sit down to wait, like everyone else.

biggerinside.label: Bigger on the Inside
biggerinside.blurb: A small plain room with a plain door. You open it, and the library opens with it, further than the building could possibly go.

bookbridge.label: The Book Bridge
bookbridge.blurb: Two platforms, and between them a walkway laid along the top of a row of bookcases. You are walking on a shelf. The shelf does not seem to mind.

bookfall.label: The Cascade
bookfall.blurb: The shelves come down from the ceiling in steps too tall to climb, as if the books were pouring out of somewhere. Some of them have landed.

bookshaft.label: The Book Shaft
bookshaft.blurb: Four walls of books, straight up and straight down, and a narrow walkway round each floor. Somewhere in there is the one you want. It is probably not on this floor.

bridgepit.label: The Chasm
bridgepit.blurb: A crack runs through the floor, lit from somewhere below. There are books down there too. There are always books down there.

bridges.label: The Bridges
bridges.blurb: Four bridges cross a room eight metres deep, and the floor down there is bookcases as far as the walls. The stair looks like it was an afterthought. It probably was.

cages.label: The Archive Cages
cages.blurb: The books here are kept behind bars, for their protection or for yours. Nobody has the keys. The stair in the middle goes all the way up to a hatch that is only painted on.

canyon.label: The Shelf Canyon
canyon.blurb: The shelves go up and up. The sky is a crack far overhead. The way back is the way you came, if you can remember which way that was.

cardcatalogue.label: The Card Catalogue
cardcatalogue.blurb: Somewhere in these drawers is a card for every book in the library, including yours. The drawers are the size of cars. One of them has been left open.

carrels.label: The Carrels
carrels.blurb: Row after row of study carrels, each with its lamp lit and its chair pushed in, each exactly like the last. Choose one. It makes no difference which.

carriages.label: The Carriages
carriages.blurb: Compartments either side of a corridor, like a night train. The windows look out onto bookshelves. Nobody checks your ticket; nobody has one.

catalog.label: The Card Catalogue
catalog.blurb: Every drawer is full of cards, and every card is for a book. None of them is in order. Some of them are about you.

cathedral.label: The Cathedral
cathedral.blurb: A cathedral, and the light through the rose window is the colour of every sermon you ever slept through. The pews face the glass. There is no altar, only a book.

ceilingdoor.label: The Door in the Ceiling
ceilingdoor.blurb: A stair climbs to a trapdoor that someone has left open. High in the north wall a door stands ajar, and no ladder in the room is long enough.

chairmountain.label: The Chair Mountain
chairmountain.blurb: Every chair anyone ever got up from and did not come back to. Somebody has laid a carpet to the top, and somebody else has left the lamps on.

chandelier.label: The Chandelier
chandelier.blurb: A ballroom, with the chandelier lit and the chairs set out, and nobody. The floor has been polished for a dance that has been going to start for a very long time.

chapel.label: The Chapel
chapel.blurb: The windows glow though there is nothing behind them. The book on the lectern is open at your page.

chute.label: The Chute
chute.blurb: An iron stair turns round and round the wall of a round shaft, one turn to a floor. It does not end at the top, or the bottom. The middle is empty all the way down.

cliff.label: The Cliff
cliff.blurb: Two walls of books face each other across a gap, fourteen metres high. The catwalks were built for someone braver than you, and for someone who knew which book they wanted.

clock.label: The Clock Room
clock.blurb: A clock the size of a wall, stopped at three minutes to eleven. The door has eaten five, six and seven. You wait for it to tick. It does not.

cloister.label: The Great Cloister
cloister.blurb: A courtyard under an open sky, and four trees that do not move when the wind does not blow. Someone has left a light on upstairs.

coil.label: The Coil
coil.blurb: The corridor turns left, and left, and left. At the end of it there is a chair, and a lamp, and nothing else, and it is very restful.

colonnade.label: The Colonnade
colonnade.blurb: Columns, and more columns, too close together, like trees planted by someone who had only read about forests. The light comes down between them.

corridor.label: The Endless Corridor
corridor.blurb: A corridor, and lamps, and books, and more corridor. Perspective is doing most of the work here, and it is tired.

corridor_doors.label: The Hall of Doors
corridor_doors.blurb: Thirty-two doors and not one of them opens. The exit signs are very sure of themselves. Light shows under some of the doors, and once, you think, a shadow.

courtyard.label: The Courtyard
courtyard.blurb: Sky. Real sky, or something painted to look like it, over a cloister and a dry fountain. It never rains.

crossvault.label: The Nine Bays
crossvault.blurb: Nine vaulted bays, each with its lamp and its books, each very like the last. You count them twice and get ten.

deadend.label: The Dead End
deadend.blurb: Four doors, four signs. Three of them are painted on. You check all three anyway, and so does everybody.

deepstepwell.label: The Deep Stepwell
deepstepwell.blurb: The floor steps down, shelf by shelf, to a square hole. Through it you can see the same steps going down to the same hole, and the underside of this one hanging over them.

dollhouse.label: The Dollhouse
dollhouse.blurb: Along the north wall somebody has built the library again, at a tenth of the size, and left all its lamps on. Its front door is just big enough, if you kneel.

dormitory.label: The Dormitory
dormitory.blurb: Beds, made. Every one of them made, and a book on every pillow-shelf. Someone expects a lot of guests.

drafting.label: The Drafting Room
drafting.blurb: Every table has the same plan pinned to it, a building with no doors, and every one is exactly as unfinished as the last.

elevators.label: The Lift Lobby
elevators.blurb: You press the button. It lights. Somewhere far above, or below, something begins to move, and keeps moving, and never arrives.

empty.label: An Empty Room
empty.blurb: Nothing here but a bulb and a book. Someone left the book. Nobody has come back for it.

escher.label: The Stair Plaza
escher.blurb: Stairs go up to bridges that go over stairs that go down to landings under bridges. You are fairly sure you have been on this one before.

gallerybust.label: The Busts
gallerybust.blurb: A gallery of stone heads on pedestals, and every one has turned to face the wall. You do not see any of them move. You check.

giantdesk.label: The Desk
giantdesk.blurb: Somebody is writing a letter on a desk the size of a parish. The pen has been put down mid-sentence. You would not like to meet the hand.

glasscase.label: The Display Cases
glasscase.blurb: Each case holds a single book, open on velvet and lit like a relic. There is no glass. Nobody has ever said what makes these ones special.

globe.label: The Globe
globe.blurb: A globe of some other world, caged in bronze hoops. None of the coastlines are ones you know. The library is not marked on it.

grandstair.label: The Staircase Gallery
grandstair.blurb: Two grand staircases climb to a landing in the middle of the hall. There is nothing up there but a chair, which is facing the wrong way.

greatdome.label: The Great Dome
greatdome.blurb: A dome as round as the inside of a thought, and under the hole in its top a globe with nothing drawn on it.

greatmaze.label: The Great Maze
greatmaze.blurb: Walls of books a little higher than you can see over. The way out is the way you came in, or one of the other seven.

greatstair.label: The Great Stair
greatstair.blurb: A staircase built for a procession that never arrived. It climbs, turns, climbs again, and delivers you with great ceremony to more shelves.

hanging.label: The Hanging Shelves
hanging.blurb: The bookcases hang on chains, some high, some low. The chains creak. You would rather not know what they are fixed to.

heap.label: The Heap
heap.blurb: All the books from all the shelves, in one pile. It is quite stable. There is an armchair on the top, which raises the question of who carried it up.

hypostyle.label: The Hypostyle
hypostyle.blurb: Pillars of books, three metres apart, in every direction you look. Some of the lamps in the ceiling have not been lit for a very long time.

keyhole.label: The Keyhole
keyhole.blurb: The north wall of the upper hall is a lock, and the lock is open. Through the keyhole the library goes down, and down.

ladderhall.label: The Ladder Hall
ladderhall.blurb: The shelves go up seven metres and the ladders go most of the way. Somebody has left a book on the top rung of every one.

lampforest.label: The Lamp Forest
lampforest.blurb: Somebody left all the lamps on, and then the lamps grew. It is dark between them, and quiet, the way a wood is quiet.

lanterns.label: The Lantern Hall
lanterns.blurb: Someone lit every one of these lanterns and hung them at every height they could think of. The candles do not burn down.

lecture.label: The Lecture Theatre
lecture.blurb: The lecture has just ended, or is about to begin. The boards are full, and the proof on them goes on past the edge.

liftshaft.label: The Lift Shaft
liftshaft.blurb: An iron cage round an empty shaft, and a gate drawn shut. Above it a dial shows which floor the lift is on. The needle has not moved in living memory, and nobody here is living.

longgallery.label: The Long Gallery
longgallery.blurb: Busts on pedestals face each other across the aisle, all the way down. None of them is anyone you have heard of, and all of them are looking at you.

lowroom.label: The Low Room
lowroom.blurb: The ceiling is just above your head and stays there. The columns go on in every direction, and most of the lamps are off.

maproom.label: The Map Room
maproom.blurb: A map of the library, to scale, if the scale is generous. There is a pin in it. The pin is not where you are.

mezzanine.label: The Mezzanine
mezzanine.blurb: Two galleries hang along the walls on posts no thicker than a broom handle. They have held so far.

mirror.label: The Symmetric Room
mirror.blurb: Everything on this side of the arches is on the other side too, the other way round. There is a chair on each side, and you are not sure which one you were sitting in.

moat.label: The Moat
moat.blurb: An island with one desk on it, and a dry moat round it lined with books. Whoever built the bridges did not trust you to jump.

nooks.label: The Nooks
nooks.blurb: A chair for everyone, each in its own little cave, each facing out, each with its lamp on. The chairs are warm, as if someone just got up.

octagon.label: The Octagon
octagon.blurb: Eight walls, eight niches, eight ways the light falls. You count the doors twice and get a different answer each time.

onebook.label: One Book
onebook.blurb: There is one book in this hall, lying open. You could walk across it. People do; there are footprints in the margins.

orangery.label: The Orangery
orangery.blurb: A glasshouse, and above the glass, a sky. The trees are in good health and have never fruited. Nobody waters them.

organ.label: The Organ
organ.blurb: An organ the size of a wall, and no one to play it. The stops are labelled in a language that is almost yours.

outside.label: The Outside
outside.blurb: Outside. Sky, paving, trees, a fountain. For a moment you almost believe it, and then you notice the lamps are lit at noon and the trees are made of iron.

panopticon.label: The Panopticon
panopticon.blurb: Every aisle runs straight to the tower in the middle. The windows in the tower are dark, which is not the same as empty.

pencilforest.label: The Pencil Wood
pencilforest.blurb: A wood of pencils, all sharpened, standing in their own shavings. It smells of cedar and of school. Nobody has written anything with them yet.

pillarabyss.label: The Pillar Abyss
pillarabyss.blurb: The doorway lets you out onto a ledge sixteen metres above a floor you can barely see. The bridges are railed. Someone thought of that, at least.

pillarbooks.label: The Book Columns
pillarbooks.blurb: The columns are books, all the way round and all the way up. You try not to think about which ones are holding up the ceiling.

portrait.label: The Portrait Gallery
portrait.blurb: Hundreds of frames, and nobody in any of them. One is a window, or a painting of the sky good enough to pass for one.

radial.label: The Radial Stacks
radial.blurb: Every aisle leads to the desk. The desk is staffed, you are sure of it, just not at the moment.

readingplain.label: The Reading Plain
readingplain.blurb: Reading tables to the horizon, every lamp lit, every chair pushed in. Nobody reads here. Perhaps they all found what they were looking for.

rings.label: The Rings
rings.blurb: A maze, but a polite one: the shelves are low enough to see the middle, and the middle has a chair. Getting there is another matter.

rotunda.label: The Rotunda
rotunda.blurb: A drum of books under a dome, and a circle of sky at the top that never changes. Everything here faces the middle, including you.

scissor.label: The Scissor Stairs
scissor.blurb: Flights of stairs zigzag up an open shaft, a landing every half floor. From the rail you can see them going up out of sight and down out of sight, identical, the whole way.

scriptorium.label: The Scriptorium
scriptorium.blurb: Sixteen desks, sixteen candles, sixteen books open at the same page. The ink in every well is still wet.

seaofshelves.label: The Sea of Shelves
seaofshelves.blurb: Stacks, and aisles, and stacks, under a ceiling low enough to be personal. Somewhere out there a lamp is buzzing, which is odd, because none of them are electric.

secret_crawl.label: The Crawlspace
secret_crawl.blurb: You had to crawl to get in here. Someone else did too, once, and brought a chair, a lamp and a book, and never took them away.

secret_reading.label: The Hidden Reading Room
secret_reading.blurb: The bookcase was not really there. Behind it, somebody kept a little room of their own, and left the candles burning.

secret_vault.label: The Vault
secret_vault.blurb: Somebody built a vault in here, with a door a foot thick, and then left it standing open. Whatever was worth guarding, it is still here. It is a book.

shrine.label: The Shrine
shrine.blurb: One book, on its own, behind a rope, with more candles than anyone could light. Whoever keeps them lit is very quiet about it.

shrinkcorridor.label: The Shrinking Corridor
shrinkcorridor.blurb: The corridor narrows as you go. So do the doors, and the bookcases, and the lamps. You tell yourself it is perspective until you have to duck.

stairhall.label: The Stair Hall
stairhall.blurb: A stair goes round the walls of a tall hall, one side at a time, and arrives at a gallery lined with books. It is a long way round for one floor.

stairsnowhere.label: Stairs to Nowhere
stairsnowhere.blurb: Every stair here is well made, handsomely railed, and goes nowhere. Climb one anyway. Everyone does.

stairwell.label: The Stairwell
stairwell.blurb: Up one stair, round the gallery, down the other, and you are back where you began. It is very good exercise, if you have forever.

steppedhall.label: The Stepped Hall
steppedhall.blurb: The floor steps down toward the middle of the hall, shelf by shelf, and up again the other side. The reading tables are at the bottom, where the quiet collects.

stepwell_s.label: The Stepwell
stepwell_s.blurb: A well with no water, only stairs: little flights that meet and part and meet again all the way down. At the bottom somebody has set out a table.

study.label: The Study
study.blurb: A fire, a deep chair, a lamp on the desk: everything a study should have, spread across a room the size of a church. The fire has been lit for you.

sunkenstair.label: The Descent
sunkenstair.blurb: A staircase as wide as the room goes down to a reading floor and comes up again on the other side. Nobody has ever gone down it and come up the same side.

tallroom.label: The Narrow Room
tallroom.blurb: The walls are books and they go up and up, and the sky is a crack. It is a very tall room with nowhere in it.

tearoom.label: The Tea Room
tearoom.blurb: Every table is laid for two. The tea is always hot. Nobody has ever been seen pouring it.

telephones.label: The Telephone Room
telephones.blurb: Twenty booths, and every line is busy. If you pick one up you hear breathing, and then someone says your name, and then the dialling tone.

terracedstacks.label: The Terraces of Stacks
terracedstacks.blurb: The floor goes down in steps, and the shelves go down with it, the way a hillside goes down to a river. There is no river.

terraces.label: The Terraces
terraces.blurb: The floor climbs in terraces to a table at the top, and every step is a shelf of books. The ceiling climbs the same way, as if the room had been folded in half.

theatre.label: The Little Theatre
theatre.blurb: The house is dark and the footlights are up. There is an armchair on the stage, and a book on the armchair. You have the feeling you are expected to go on.

tiers.label: The Tiers
tiers.blurb: Balconies above balconies, all of them lined with books, all of them empty. From the top one you can see everything except who is on the one below.

titanlamp.label: The Reading Lamp
titanlamp.blurb: Someone left the lamp on. It is the only light for a long way, and it falls on a single page the size of a field. You cannot read it from down here.

tunnel.label: The Tunnel
tunnel.blurb: A lamp every two metres, and the lamps go on until they meet. The books on either side are within reach the whole way, which somehow makes it worse.

tunnels.label: The Burrows
tunnels.blurb: The shelves have closed in until there is no room left, only tunnels. Something made them. You hope it was people.

twinnaves.label: The Twin Naves
twinnaves.blurb: Two naves, side by side, the same in every particular. Stand in the arcade between them and try to remember which one you came in by.

upside.label: The Upside-Down Room
upside.blurb: Someone has furnished the ceiling. The books stay on their shelves out of politeness. Try not to look up for too long.

vestibule.label: The Vestibule
vestibule.blurb: The arches go on and on, getting smaller, to a little door at the end. It takes eleven steps to get there. It should take a hundred.

voidhall.label: The Void Hall
voidhall.blurb: The far walls are only a rumour of lamplight. In the middle a staircase climbs into the dark to one lit book, which is almost certainly not yours.

waiting.label: The Waiting Room
waiting.blurb: Every chair faces the same door. The clock says ten to four. You find you have already sat down.

ziggurat.label: The Ziggurat
ziggurat.blurb: Someone stacked the books into a pyramid and climbed it, and left the book at the top open. The page is blank on both sides.
